checks.ref:
command:branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in gnomish/*) task=${branch#gnomish/} ;; *) task=local ;; esac
dir=temporary-docs/gnomish/$task
if [ ! -f "$dir/review-code.md" ]; then
  echo "no audit report at $dir/review-code.md - write it before finishing the round, see .gnomish/stages/review-code/instructions.md"
  exit 1
fi

command:branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in gnomish/*) task=${branch#gnomish/} ;; *) task=local ;; esac
dir=temporary-docs/gnomish/$task
report=$dir/review-code.md
expected=$(sed -n 's/^Change:[[:space:]]*//p' "$dir/change.md" | head -1)
change=$(sed -n 's/^## Implementation Audit:[[:space:]]*//p' "$report" | head -1 | tr -d '`')
if [ "$change" != "$expected" ]; then
  echo "the report's '## Implementation Audit:' heading names '$change', but this task's change is '$expected' - audit that change and name it exactly"
  exit 1
fi
for section in '### Summary' '### Tasks' '### Requirements' '### Project rules' '### Code quality' '### Test quality' '### Security' '### Recommendations, ordered' '### Verdict'; do
  grep -q "^$section" "$report" || { echo "the report has no '$section' section - keep the layout of step 9 of .claude/commands/audit-implementation.md"; exit 1; }
done
section() { awk -v heading="$1" 'index($0, heading) == 1 { inside = 1; next } /^##/ { inside = 0 } inside' "$report"; }
recommendations=$(section '### Recommendations, ordered')
items=$(printf '%s\n' "$recommendations" | grep -cE '^[0-9]+\. \*\*(CRITICAL|WARNING|SUGGESTION) — ' || true)
for field in Problem Impact Fix 'Fix risk'; do
  count=$(printf '%s\n' "$recommendations" | grep -cE "^[[:space:]]+$field: " || true)
  if [ "$count" != "$items" ]; then
    echo "Recommendations has $items item(s) of the form 'N. **SEVERITY — title** (\`location\`)' but $count indented '$field:' line(s) - every item carries one Problem, Impact, Fix and Fix risk line each, as .claude/rules/review-recommendations.md shows"
    exit 1
  fi
done
# Emphasis and case are tolerated: a usable verdict is not worth a round over markup.
verdict=$(section '### Verdict' | grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' | head -1 | tr -d '*_`' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
blocking=$(printf '%s\n' "$recommendations" | grep -cE '^[0-9]+\. \*\*(CRITICAL|WARNING) — ' || true)
case "$verdict" in
  "not ready"*) [ "$blocking" -gt 0 ] || { echo "the Verdict reads 'not ready' but no recommendation is CRITICAL or WARNING - the Verdict opens with 'ready to archive'"; exit 1; } ;;
  "ready to archive"*) [ "$blocking" -eq 0 ] || { echo "there are $blocking CRITICAL/WARNING recommendation(s), so the Verdict opens with 'not ready', not 'ready to archive'"; exit 1; } ;;
  *) echo "the Verdict section opens with '$verdict'; it must open with exactly 'ready to archive' or 'not ready'"; exit 1 ;;
esac

command:branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in gnomish/*) task=${branch#gnomish/} ;; *) task=local ;; esac
dir=temporary-docs/gnomish/$task
dirty=$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all | sed 's/^...//' | grep -vxF "$dir/review-code.md" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
if [ -n "$dirty" ]; then
  echo "this stage writes only $dir/review-code.md, but the working copy also carries:"
  echo "$dirty"
  echo "if you made these edits, undo each of them yourself and nothing else - an audit changes nothing; its recommendations are for the next stage."
  echo "if you did not: leave every one of them exactly as it is - do not stash, restore, checkout or clean anything - and escalate through \$GNOMISH_DECISION_FILE naming the paths."
  exit 1
fi
